Shaun Finnie

Democratic candidate for U.S. Representative, District 2, Harris County, Texas · Open seat

Energy investment banker; former oil and gas lawyer

Shaun Finnie is a Democrat and first-time candidate who lives in The Woodlands, Texas. He worked as an oil and gas lawyer and then spent about 30 years in energy investment banking. He was unopposed in the March 3, 2026 Democratic primary for Texas's 2nd Congressional District and faces Republican Steve Toth in the November 3, 2026 general election for the open seat.

Where Finnie stands

Social Security, Medicare and Medicaid
Pledges to protect Social Security, Medicare and Medicaid benefits for middle-class Americans.
Federal spending and debt
Says government should 'never spend more than what we can afford' and names the growing national debt as a concern for families.
Tariffs and cost of living
Calls for removing the Trump administration's tariffs, raising the federal minimum wage, and making childcare and education more affordable.
Health care
Supports restoring the enhanced Affordable Care Act premium assistance and creating a public insurance option to compete with private insurers.
Flooding
Lists dredging the San Jacinto River, adding floodgates at Lake Houston, and stopping development in floodplains as priorities.
Energy
Supports cleaner energy and cutting emissions. Says regulations should not give large corporations advantages over smaller operators.
Immigration
Supports immigration reform, due process, and a path to citizenship for long-established residents who contribute to their communities.
Education and childcare
Supports universal pre-kindergarten, affordable childcare, and investment in public schools.
Veterans
Supports investing in programs that reduce veteran homelessness and support veterans with disabilities, including access to housing and health care.

Background

  • Democratic nominee for U.S. House, Texas District 2 (2026); unopposed in the March 3, 2026 primary
  • Energy investment banker for about 30 years, focused on oil and gas mergers and acquisitions; affiliated with Evercore and took a leave of absence in June 2025
  • Former oil and gas lawyer
  • Education: B.A. in Economics, law degree, and MBA (Kellogg School of Management), all from Northwestern University
  • Lives in The Woodlands, Texas (about 19 years); grew up in Canada
  • Endorsed by the Texas AFL-CIO
